resource: Refusal detail field appended to step, use and item move results
allocation_impact: Fixed two-byte suffix; a repeated, misplaced or unknown detail is refused before the result is decoded.
notes: PARITY-REFUSAL-DETAIL-1. Each result bound (MAX_ITEM_MOVE_RESULT_BYTES, MAX_USE_RESULT_BYTES, MAX_STEP_RESULT_BYTES) grows by this suffix only under capability 66.
